answer: Prayers & Duties >> Qurbani (Slaughtering) Question ID: 50794 Country: India Title: Qurbani Meat Preserving Question: Many people preserve the Qurbani meat keeping frozen in their fridges for few months to eat later. Is it allowed and permissible to do so? Answer ID: 50794 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 348/270/D=03/1435) It is lawful but it is better to give one third in charity to the poor and needy ones and give one third to the relatives and near ones. But if he did not do so and kept all the meat at home then also it is lawful. جاء فى الحديث قال: كلوا واطعموا وادخروا (مشكوة ص 232) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
